description: Download an external image URL into R2 and attach it as the post's featuredImage. Replaces the manual flow of pasting external URLs (which break when the source goes down). Validates content-type starts with `image/` and rejects payloads larger than 20 MB. No AI credits charged — only standard storage.

sourceUrl.description: Public http(s) URL to fetch the image from. Must respond with an image/* content-type.
